data.name: Marak
data.gender_notes: Marak is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Marak is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Mara', which refers to the God of Death in Hindu mythology. This name is believed to bestow the bearer with courage, protection, and strength, as the God Mara is known to vanquish all fears and adversities. The name Marak carries the meaning “Mara, the God of Death” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi, Marathi. Parents who choose Marak usually hope their child will grow to embody mara, the god of death and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the triumph over fear and death, representing the indomitable spirit of the individual.

This name carries an aura of power and strength, as it is derived from the God who has the power to over life and death. It is a unique and significant name that represents the triumph of life over death.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the God Mara is revered as the one who bestows courage, protection, and strength upon his devotees. The name Marak carries the spiritual significance of having the blessings of the God of Death. It signifies that the bearer of this name has the inner strength to face the challenges of life and the fearlessness to vanquish all adversities, just like Mara, the God of Death, who has the power to overcome the fear of death itself.
